hint: Scroll for more. Swipe the bank cards to switch accounts. Tap any box to open it.
welcomeBody: A one-minute walk through Home: what each box is and what to tap. You can leave at any point.
homeTourBody: This strip turns every few seconds. Each slide is one thing Horizon does; Open takes you there.
homeBalanceBody: Every account you have uploaded or connected, in one total per currency.
homeIncomeBody: How you earn, read from your statements: your salary and employer, or what comes in each month.
homeMonthBody: Came in, went out, stayed with you. Open it for the full report and your health score.
homeCardsBody: One card per account. Swipe or tap to switch; the sections below follow the card you pick.
homeActionsBody: Upload a statement, see bills, open the calendar or your goals from here.
homeBanksBody: Where the money sits, as a doughnut, with the health ring beside it.
homeForecastBody: Where this account's balance is heading up to your next pay day, with the payments that move it.
homeDoneBody: Every other page has a short tour of its own: open About Horizon and tap Demo on any box.
banksCoverageBody: Each bank with the months its statements cover. Gaps show where to upload next.
banksConnectBody: Upload a statement file, connect through the account aggregator, or a US bank through Plaid.
spendingMonthsBody: Money in and out for each month, as a list or a chart.
spendingPayeesBody: Tap a slice to see one kind of spending up close, or a payee to see every payment to them.
spendingListBody: Search, filter, and change a name or category; Horizon remembers it for next time.
billsTilesBody: What goes out and comes in on a rhythm each month, and what is due in the next 30 days.
billsForecastBody: Your balance ahead for each account, with the day it might dip below zero.
goalsBoardBody: Set a target and a monthly amount; each goal fills up as your balances grow.
chargesTilesBody: Minimum-balance penalties, SMS and card fees, ATM and bounce charges, added up.
chargesListBody: Each bank's charges by kind and month, with a ready request to ask for them back.
loansTilesBody: What all your lenders take a month, and how much of your income that is.
loansOrderBody: The loan that costs the most to keep, with a plan to clear it.
loansSubsBody: Streaming, apps and memberships: what they cost together and which have stopped. Name any that arrive under a store's name.
detailPayeesBody: Tap a slice of the doughnut: who the money went to, month by month, and the days it goes out.
forecastTilesBody: What goes out and comes in over the next days, and the lowest point.
forecastGridBody: Salary day, EMI days and bill days on their dates, with the expected balance under each.
forecastPanelBody: The same forecast on Bills, drawn from your pay day to the next.
reportTilesBody: Money in, money out, and what stayed with you.
reportPartsBody: EMIs against income, what is spoken for before the month starts, and what was left.
checksListBody: When a payment is unclear, Horizon asks. Each answer sharpens your charts and your income figure.
